theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_scaled_lp_ball_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (z : Amb n ℓ) (r ρ : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ ρ → closedBall z r ⊆ closedBall 0 ρ → V.scaledLpNorm H p z r ≤ V.scaledLpNorm H p 0 ρ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → V.scaledLpNorm H p 0 ρ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ → V.weight (closedBall z r) < ⊤ → ∫ x in closedBall z r, ‖H x‖ ∂V.weight ≤ δ * ρ ^ ((n : ℝ) / p - 1) * (V.weight (closedBall z r)).toReal ^ (1 - 1 / p)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
